note: Which groups of the clip seed layer (docs/clip-data.md, scripts/clip-seed-lib.mjs DATASET_PHASES) make the data of each chapter, and what is proven. The proof states come from the 'State of the proof' section of docs/clip-data.md: RUN_VERIFIED (ran on a stack and read back), WRITTEN_NOT_RUN (written and reviewed, not run end to end), NOT_DONE (no seed exists). A chapter that needs a group that is not RUN_VERIFIED is listed as at risk in the shooting script, never hidden.
